target.statement: SROCC of RADN on the NTIRE 2021 IQA Challenge validation dataset (PIPAL) = 0.8438
target.dataset: PIPAL (NTIRE 2021 Perceptual Image Quality Assessment Challenge validation set)

compute.basis: No code released; RADN (deformable conv + patch-level attention + contrastive pretraining) must be reimplemented from scratch and trained on PIPAL (250 refs, 29k distorted images, 1.13M judgments) with 32-patch sampling and small batch size, which is a multi-hour training run even on CPU.

blockers: No code or configs released by the authors
PIPAL is large (~29k distorted images, 1.13M human judgments) requiring substantial download and preprocessing
Contrastive pretraining + full RADN training is long (paper reports ~20 min/epoch even with efficient Siamese backprop)
Exact SROCC depends on train/val split and training schedule not fully specified
title: Region-Adaptive Deformable Network for Image Quality Assessment
